# sizestr

Source: https://github.com/zaczero/sizestr/blob/main/README.md

# sizestr


Simple and fast formatting of sizes for Python.

## Installation

```sh
pip install sizestr
```

## Basic usage

```py
from sizestr import sizestr

sizestr(10000)  # '9.77 KiB'
sizestr(-42)  # '-42 B'
sizestr(float('inf'))  # '(inf)'
```
